<details>
<summary>Transcript</summary>

This is an experiment, one of hopefully many more to come.

One of the reasons why the blog went on a 4 year hiatus is because I had been traveling and no longer had the setup and gear which I originally used when I started this project: the fancy Wacom drawing tablet and my Linux desktop PC.

Recently I purchased a borderline "antique" drawing tablet and it motivated me to go through the trouble of finding the open source unofficial drivers and old software.

The software was and still is great, but the tablet is dog shit.

So the question is...
